## 🖼️ One image, filling the box

The **Gallery** can show a single file — paste one line into **Images come from → A list of files I paste** — and **Display → Single image** draws just that file. Two switches then decide how it fills its card:

- **Image fit** — *Letterbox* shows the whole file, *Fill crop* covers the box edge to edge.
- **Frame → Bare** — takes the title bar, the padding and the card's own title away, so the picture reaches the edges. On the video beside it, the same setting removes the player's file line and (for one file) its transport, leaving the video and its native controls.

The tiles beside this note are the same two switches: **cover**, **letterbox**, a **bare video**, and a grid with **Show captions off**. Click any tile to open its Commons file page.
